name: nuits-receipts
description: Self-hosted receipt and invoice reader that runs on Cloudflare Workers: reads receipts with Workers AI, matches them to bank CSV exports and prepares a monthly CSV for your accountant.
author: Bapusaheb Shankaragouda Patil / Nuits

scripts.dev: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.cache/config WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler dev --local --config wrangler.local.jsonc
scripts.migrate: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.cache/config WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.local.jsonc
scripts.format: prettier --write src test scripts/generate-samples.ts scripts/setup.mjs scripts/deploy.mjs scripts/deploy-lib.mjs scripts/deploy.test.ts scripts/app-tokens.mjs scripts/app-tokens.test.ts scripts/schema.test.ts scripts/eval-extraction.ts scripts/eval-extraction.test.ts vitest.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json
scripts.lint: prettier --check src test scripts/generate-samples.ts scripts/setup.mjs scripts/deploy.mjs scripts/deploy-lib.mjs scripts/deploy.test.ts scripts/app-tokens.mjs scripts/app-tokens.test.ts scripts/schema.test.ts scripts/eval-extraction.ts scripts/eval-extraction.test.ts vitest.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run test:scripts

NUITS_PASSWORD.description: Your sign-in password. Use at least 16 characters and a value unique to this install, for example from `openssl rand -base64 24`. Example values are refused.

AUTH_USERNAME.description: User name for signing in. Defaults to `owner`.

ALLOWED_SENDER_EMAILS.description: Comma-separated addresses allowed to email receipts in. Leave empty to use uploads only. Email also needs an Email Routing **Send to a Worker** rule, which the button does not create.

RECEIPT_ADDRESS.description: The address you route to this Worker in Email Routing, on your own domain. Shown in the app. Optional.

FORWARD_COPY_TO.description: Optional. Forward a copy of every email the Worker receives, from any sender, to this one address (for example one-time codes). It must be a verified destination address in Email Routing. Leave empty to turn it off.

INVOICES_ADDRESS.description: Optional. A second address, routed to this Worker like the receipt address, for copies of sales invoices you send. Must differ from the receipt address. Leave empty to turn it off.

SELLER_NAMES.description: Optional. Your business names as they appear on your own invoices, comma separated. Sales invoices that name someone else as the seller are flagged.

PRODUCTS_JSON.description: Products or projects to group costs by, as JSON, for example `[{"id":"general","label":"General"}]`.

DEFAULT_PRODUCT.description: The product id new receipts start with. Must be in `PRODUCTS_JSON`.

ACCOUNTANT_LABEL.description: Who receives the month's files, shown on the Send step. Defaults to `your accountant`.

AI_MODE.description: `live` reads receipts with Workers AI. `mock` uses a fixed test extractor with no AI or network calls, for trying the app only. Defaults to `live`.

APP_NAME.description: Name shown in the page title, header and sign-in prompt. Defaults to `Nuits Receipts`.

EXPORT_PREFIX.description: File name prefix for exports, as in `receipts-2026-09.csv` and the month ZIP `receipts-2026-09.zip`. Letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`. Defaults to `receipts`.

SOURCE_REPOSITORY.description: Optional `https://` URL of your copy of the code. If set, the footer links the version to its release notes. Leave empty to hide the link.

ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Optional. Cloudflare Access team domain, such as `your-team.cloudflareaccess.com`. Set it with `ACCESS_AUD` and `ACCESS_ALLOWED_EMAILS` to sign in through Access instead of the password. Needs your own domain; see docs/ENVIRONMENT.md. Leave empty to use the password.

ACCESS_AUD.description: Optional. The Access application's Audience (AUD) tag. Leave empty to use the password.

ACCESS_ALLOWED_EMAILS.description: Optional. Emails the app accepts from Cloudflare Access, comma separated. Leave empty to use the password.

SEND_HINT.description: Optional. One line shown under the month's download button, for example where your accountant wants the files. Leave empty to show nothing.

MS_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional. Application (client) ID of your Microsoft Entra app, to upload each month straight into a OneDrive folder. Needs the `MS_CLIENT_SECRET` and `ONEDRIVE_TOKEN_KEY` secrets too; see docs/ENVIRONMENT.md. Leave empty to keep it off.

MS_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional secret for OneDrive upload: the client secret value of your Microsoft Entra app.

ONEDRIVE_TOKEN_KEY.description: Optional secret for OneDrive upload: 32 random bytes in base64 (`openssl rand -base64 32`), used to encrypt the stored Microsoft sign-in.

DB.description: D1 database for receipts, bank rows and rules. Created for you; the schema is applied on deploy.

ORIGINALS.description: Private R2 bucket for original documents and emails. Never made public.

AI.description: Workers AI, used for Cloudflare's Clairic extraction model (preview) and categorisation. Usage is billed to your account.
